tagline: Internet ki phone book, ek-ek level karke dhoondi jaati hai.
description: DNS example.com jaise names ko IP addresses mein badalta hai. Aapka laptop ek recursive resolver se poochta hai, jo root servers se .com servers tak aur phir domain ke apne server tak tree chalta hai, aur jawab cache kar leta hai taaki agla lookup turant ho.
facts: Har record ka ek TTL hota hai

normal.name: example.com ka pehla lookup, phir cache se
normal.summary: Resolver root → .com → example.com chalta hai, laptop ko jawab deta hai, aur agla lookup apne cache se serve karta hai.

steps.title: Resolver se pucho
steps.desc: Laptop ek chhota sa sawal bhejta hai
steps.detail: Browser ko example.com ka address chahiye. Laptop apne configured resolver, yaani ISP ke server 192.0.2.53 ko 40-something byte ka UDP packet bhejta hai. RD (recursion desired) flag ka matlab: please poora lookup mere liye karo aur final answer lekar aao.

quiz.q: Resolver ka cache khali hai. Wo sabse pehle kisse poochega?
quiz.why: Kuch cached na ho to resolver ko sirf root servers ke addresses pata hote hain (apni built-in hints file se). Sab kuch root se shuru hota hai.

steps.title: Root server se pucho
steps.desc: Root ko nahi pata, lekin pata hai .com kaun chalata hai
steps.detail: Resolver root server se wahi sawal puchta hai, RD ke bina, kyunki use pointer chahiye, ehsaan nahi. Root referral se jawab deta hai: answer nahi, lekin authority section mein .com ke NS records, aur additional section mein unke IP addresses. In addresses ko glue kehte hain, aur ye resolver ko ek aur lookup se bachate hain.

quiz.q: Root apne reply mein a.gtld-servers.net ka IP address kyun daalta hai?
options: Taaki resolver ko us name ka alag lookup na karna pade
Kyunki root gtld-servers.net ke liye authoritative hai
quiz.why: Glue ke bina resolver ko .com ke baare mein kuch poochne se pehle a.gtld-servers.net ka lookup karna padta. Glue use address seedha de deta hai.

steps.title: .com server se pucho
steps.desc: Ek aur referral, ek level neeche
steps.detail: Ab resolver a.gtld-servers.net se poochta hai. .com registry ke paas bhi example.com ke addresses nahi hain, lekin use pata hai ki domain owner ne kaunse name servers register kiye: ns1 aur ns2.example.com. Ye names example.com ke andar hi hain, isliye yahan glue zaroori hai, warna resolver gol-gol ghoomta rehta.

steps.title: example.com ke server se pucho
steps.detail: Aakhir mein resolver ns1.example.com se poochta hai, jo domain owner ka apna server hai. Ise sach mein pata hai: wo A record ke saath reply karta hai aur AA (authoritative answer) flag set karta hai. 3600 seconds ka TTL kehta hai ki jawab ek ghante tak dobara use ho sakta hai.

quiz.q: Kaunsa flag dikhata hai ki ye jawab seedha domain ke apne server se aaya?
quiz.why: AA (authoritative answer) sirf wahi server set karta hai jo zone ke liye responsible hai. Cache se aaye jawab mein ye kabhi nahi hota.

steps.title: Laptop ko jawab do
steps.desc: Wahi question id, final answer, cached
steps.detail: Resolver jawab aur har referral ko cache mein rakhta hai, phir laptop ko reply karta hai. Reply laptop ka transaction id 0x3f1a aur question repeat karta hai, taaki laptop use match kar sake. RA (recursion available) dikhata hai ki resolver ne chalke kaam kiya. Poora walk 90 ms mein hua.
facts: RD, RA (AA nahi: resolver se aaya)

quiz.q: 60 seconds baad doosra customer example.com maangta hai. Use kaunsa TTL dikhega?
quiz.why: Cache TTL ko ghatata rehta hai. 60 seconds baad 3600 − 60 = 3540 seconds ki life bachti hai.

steps.title: Doosra lookup, cache se
steps.desc: Ek minute baad: koi walk nahi
steps.detail: Ek minute baad laptop phir poochta hai (browser ka apna cache clear tha). Is baar resolver ke paas jawab pehle se hai, isliye wo lagbhag 4 ms mein bina kisi aur server se baat kiye reply karta hai. TTL ghatke 3540 ho chuka hai. Isi caching ki wajah se DNS roz arabon lookups serve kar paata hai.

outro.title: Name resolve ho gaya
outro.text: Laptop ke ek sawal ke teen sawal ban gaye resolver ki taraf se: root, .com, phir example.com ka apna server. Har level ek step aur kareeb point karta gaya, aur final answer cache hua taaki agle lookup ko bahar ka traffic hi na chahiye.

nxdomain.name: Typo: NXDOMAIN
nxdomain.summary: Koi wwww.example.com type karta hai; domain ka server kehta hai ki ye name exist nahi karta.

steps.title: Typo ke liye pucho
steps.detail: User address galat type karta hai. Laptop sawal hamesha ki tarah resolver ko bhejta hai. DNS ko pata hi nahi ki ye typo hai; wo bas name lookup karta hai.

steps.title: Seedha ns1 pe jao
steps.desc: Cached referrals do trips bacha lete hain
steps.detail: Resolver ke cache mein example.com ke NS records abhi bhi hain (wo do din jeete hain), isliye wo root aur .com skip karke seedha ns1.example.com se poochta hai. Server ke paas aisa koi name nahi, aur wo NXDOMAIN (rcode 3) reply karta hai. Wo apna SOA record bhi jodta hai taaki resolver ko pata chale ki is "no" ko kitni der yaad rakh sakta hai.

quiz.q: Is baar resolver ne root se kyun nahi pucha?
options: Root typos ka jawab nahi dete
Uske cache mein example.com ke NS records abhi bhi the
Laptop ne bataya ki kahan jaana hai
NXDOMAIN lookups root skip karte hain
quiz.why: Referrals bhi kisi bhi record ki tarah cache hote hain. example.com ke NS set ka TTL 2 din tha, isliye resolver seedha domain ke apne server pe ja sakta tha.

steps.title: Laptop ko batao
steps.detail: Resolver NXDOMAIN laptop ko wapas deta hai aur negative answer ko 300 seconds ke liye cache karta hai, taaki ek hi typo ki bheed ns1 ko dobara hit na kare. Browser "site can't be reached" page dikhata hai, DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN ke saath.

quiz.q: Kya NXDOMAIN ek network failure hai?
options: Nahi, ye ek pakka jawab hai: name exist nahi karta
Nahi, iska matlab hai TCP try karo
quiz.why: NXDOMAIN ek successful lookup hai jiska result negative hai. Timeout ya SERVFAIL network ya server ka fail hona hoga.

outro.title: Ek saaf "no"
outro.text: NXDOMAIN ek authoritative statement hai ki name exist nahi karta. Ye zone ke SOA record ke saath aata hai, jiska minimum field resolvers ko batata hai ki negative answer kitni der cache karna hai.

poisoning.name: Cache poisoning ki koshish
poisoning.summary: Attacker asli server se race karke forged replies bhejta hai; random ids, random ports aur DNSSEC use rokte hain.

steps.title: Lookup trigger karo
steps.desc: Attacker resolver ko bahar bhejta hai
steps.detail: Cache poison karne ke liye attacker ko tab fake answer ghusana hota hai jab resolver asli answer ka intezaar kar raha ho. Isliye pehle wo resolver se www.example.com maangta hai, ek aisa name jo abhi cached nahi. Resolver apni query ns1.example.com ko random port se aur random transaction id ke saath bhejta hai.

steps.title: Forgeries ki bauchhaar
steps.desc: Fake answers jo ns1 hone ka dikhava karte hain
steps.detail: Attacker kai replies bhejta hai jinka source address ns1.example.com forge kiya hota hai, har ek www.example.com ko apne server pe point karta hai. Wo resolver ki query dekh nahi sakta, isliye use transaction id aur destination port dono guess karne padte hain. Resolver har wo reply drop kar deta hai jisme dono mein se koi bhi us query se match nahi karta jiska wo intezaar kar raha hai.

quiz.q: Ek forged reply mein port sahi hai lekin id 0x8c41 ki jagah 0x8c40 hai. Resolver kya karta hai?
options: Accept kar leta hai, port match hua
Kam der ke liye cache karta hai
quiz.why: Id aur port (aur question) teeno match hone chahiye. Ek bit bhi galat to wo wo reply nahi hai jiska resolver intezaar kar raha hai.

steps.title: Asli answer jeetta hai
steps.detail: ns1 ka genuine reply id 0x8c41 ke saath port 53817 pe aata hai aur accept ho jaata hai. Query ka jawab mil jaane ke baad baad ki forgeries ke paas match karne ko kuch nahi bachta. 2008 se pehle resolvers fixed source port use karte the, isliye sirf 16-bit id guess karni padti thi; Dan Kaminsky ne dikhaya ki wo seconds mein todi ja sakti thi. Random ports kaam ko hazaaron guna badha dete hain.

steps.title: DNSSEC: aakhri deewar
steps.desc: Lucky guess bhi signature pe fail ho jaata hai
steps.detail: Randomness forgery ko sirf mushkil banati hai. DNSSEC use bekaar bana deta hai: zone apne records sign karta hai, aur validating resolver har answer ka RRSIG un keys se check karta hai jo root tak chain hoti hain. Forged A record ka valid signature nahi hota, isliye use cache karne ki jagah SERVFAIL ke saath phenk diya jaayega.
facts: Signature check, guess nahi ho sakta

quiz.q: Agar attacker resolver ki queries dekh sakta hai (jaise same network path pe), to kaunsa defence phir bhi kaam karta hai?
quiz.why: On-path attacker id aur port padh ke copy kar sakta hai. Sirf cryptographic signature, jo wo bana nahi sakta, forgery ko ujagar karta hai.

outro.title: Poisoning fail ho gayi
outro.text: Cache poisoning ke liye forged reply ko ek pending query se match karna padta hai. Random transaction ids aur random source ports ise lagbhag 31 bits ka guess bana dete hain, aur DNSSEC signatures sahi guess ko bhi bekaar kar dete hain.
facts: Random id + port, 0x20 case mixing, DNSSEC
